violations.type: Motion / animation not respecting reduced-motion preference
violations.explanation: The double-tap zoom animation runs regardless of the platform's reduce-motion / disable-animations setting (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf). Users sensitive to motion cannot avoid the zoom animation.

Resetting zoom to the default view is only available via the double-tap gesture. The zoom buttons provide incremental zoom, but there is no accessible button or semantic action to reset the zoom. Panning is likewise only possible via drag gestures, which keyboard, switch and screen reader users may be unable to perform.

When the zoom level changes, including reaching the min/max limits, nothing is communicated to assistive technologies (e.g. via SemanticsService announcement or a semantic value). Screen reader users therefore get no feedback about the current zoom level.
